queries.name: FaultTagListQuery
rules: current ticket/device context is derived through memberships/RMAs/consequences
submitted historical snapshot is not current mutable truth

queries.name: FaultTagDetailQuery
returns: membership identities/current RMA and unit truth
submitted display snapshot values distinctly labeled historical

queries.name: EligibleFaultTagMembershipQuery
returns: current active submitted membership if conflicting
rules: one obligation and exact unit can be active in at most one submitted membership

queries.name: FaultTagLineageQuery
returns: resend predecessor/successors by disjoint membership scope
